subject: Vendor portal — delegation for credential rotation + minimal evidence bundle
messages:
From: Lena Park <security@greenthread.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procure@greenthread.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal: credential rotation proof + upload delegation

Hi Markus —

Thanks for onboarding to Vendr. We're running a scoped audit and require two small items to complete the profile for Greenthread's procurement sign-off:

1) Evidence that you have rotated any production-facing API/service account keys in the last 90 days (screenshot or S3 proof file naming stamp).
2) A single compressed evidence bundle containing the SOC 2 lookup (high-level), your SIG/CAIQ status map for public-facing services, and a contact for delegated uploads. 

We want to avoid repeated manual uploads. Can Redwood either:
- create a delegated upload identity for our portal (limited scope), or
- provide short-lived presigned S3 URLs we can use to pull the bundle?

If you can share a single bundle and a delegated upload account identifier, that will close our checklist and unblock procurement.

Appreciate a target by end of week if possible.

Best,
Lena Park
Security Operations
Greenthread Inc.

Attachment: vendor-evidence-template.xlsx (reference)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor portal: credential rotation proof + upload delegation

Team —

Looping you in so we can move quickly on Greenthread's request. Key asks:
- Provide evidence of API/service account key rotation in the last 90 days (ideally a timestamped audit log or signed SHA256 file we can include).
- Produce a single compressed evidence bundle (tar.gz) containing SOC 2 summary, SIG/CAIQ mapping, and minimal artifacts.
- Decide whether to provision a delegated upload account on Vendr or hand out presigned S3 links.

Ben: can you create the evidence-index.csv (list of files + brief notes) and build the bundle? 
Mina: advise on whether delegated upload is OK from security/KMS perspective (we might scope it to 'vendr-uploads@redwood' with write-only permissions).
Soojin: if we do presigned links, please prepare the least-privileged ACL and TTL (I suggest 24 hours).

I'll reply to Greenthread once we have a clear path.

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor portal: credential rotation proof + upload delegation

Markus —

Quick status:
- evidence-index.csv created (attached stub). It lists: soc2-summary.pdf, caiq-map.xlsx, sig-matrix.csv, rotation-audit.json (sha256-signed).
- I assembled a compressed package (evidence-package.tar.gz) with minimal artifacts and a README that explains provenance and redaction. Attachment: evidence-index.csv (stub)

On delegation vs presigned links:
- Security prefers presigned S3 PUT links for this one-off exchange. Delegated portal accounts require onboarding and a longer audit trail; not ideal for a single evidence push.
- Proposed flow: We generate three presigned PUT links (24-hour TTL) and include a short checklist for filenames. Greenthread uploads; we verify integrity and then pull into Vendr.

If everyone agrees, I'll generate the links and the address to give to Greenthread. Estimated time: 3 hours once approved.

-ben

Attachment: evidence-index.csv (3 rows)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <security@greenthread.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2028 17:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: credential rotation proof + upload delegation

Hi Lena —

Thank you for the clear ask and patience. We can support a minimal exchange and avoid granting a delegated portal account. Plan below:

- Evidence bundle: we've prepared a compressed package (evidence-package.tar.gz) containing a one-page SOC 2 summary, CAIQ mapping (redwood_ca_iq_map.xlsx), SIG matrix, and rotation-audit.json containing the signed timestamp of key rotation.
- Upload method: we will provide three presigned S3 PUT URLs (24-hour TTL). Please upload the files with the filenames in the attached index; metadata will be verified by our team after the upload.
- Verification & intake: once uploaded, Ben will verify checksums and we will ingest the package into Vendr on your behalf. We will sanitize any secrets and provide the intake confirmation.

Presigned links & an upload checklist are attached in a follow-up email (Ben will send the links directly to the Greenthread procurement alias to avoid exposure to other addresses).

If that works, please upload before Fri Jul 5 17:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-package.tar.gz (stub)
